definitions.title: Event definitions
definitions.subtitle: The registry that decides which event types are accepted, validated, aggregated and kept.
definitions.empty_description: Events are rejected until their type is registered here.

definitions.dialog.description: Changes reach the ingestion registry within a few minutes.
definitions.fields.key_hint: Lowercase, dot-separated (e.g. card.view). Cannot be changed later.
definitions.fields.key_locked: The key cannot be changed after creation.
definitions.fields.name: Name
definitions.fields.retention_days_hint: Days to keep raw events of this type.
definitions.fields.required_properties_h: Comma separated keys that every event must carry in properties.
definitions.fields.enabled_hint: Disabled event types are rejected at ingestion.
definitions.fields.is_public_hint: Accepted from browsers and devices via POST /v1/events. Off means backend-only.
definitions.fields.aggregate_enabled_hin: Include in hourly and daily rollups that power dashboards.
definitions.validation.key_max: Key can be at most 100 characters.
definitions.validation.key_pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
definitions.validation.name_max: Name can be at most 200 characters.
definitions.validation.category_max: Category can be at most 64 characters.
definitions.validation.schema_version_mi: Schema version must be at least 1.
definitions.validation.retention_min: Retention must be at least 1 day.
config.title: Analytics settings
config.subtitle: Runtime configuration of event ingestion, rollups and retention. Saved changes apply within about a minute.
config.section_pipeline_hint: Master switch and how events reach storage.
config.section_batching_hint: How the ingestion worker groups writes.
config.section_retention_hint: How long raw events and rollups are kept.
config.enabled_hint: When off, no events are ingested or processed.
config.event_delivery_mode_hint: Queue (async), direct write (sync) or queue with direct fallback (hybrid).
config.queue_name_hint: Asynq queue the analytics worker consumes.
config.realtime_enabled_hint: Keep today's live counters in Redis.
config.anonymize_ip_hint: Truncate IP addresses before hashing. Raw IPs are never stored.
config.read_only: You can view these settings; changing them needs the Manage analytics permission.
